pr.title: perf(context): add fast path to c.json() matching c.text() optimization

summary: This PR adds a fast path to c.json() matching the existing c.text() optimization. When no status, headers, or finalized state exists, it uses Response.json(object) directly instead of going through #newResponse(). The change is a straightforward performance optimization that mirrors the existing text() pattern.

findings.rationale: The fast path uses Response.json(object) instead of JSON.stringify(object) + #newResponse(). While functionally equivalent for the common case (no custom headers, no status override), Response.json() is a Web API that may have different behavior in edge cases or older environments. The PR description mentions Node.js benchmarks, suggesting compatibility was verified.
findings.suggestedCheck: Verify that Response.json() is available in all target environments (Node.js 18+, browsers, Cloudflare Workers, etc.) and that its behavior matches the slow path for edge cases like circular references or special JSON values.
